name: Women's All Over Print Hawaiian Shirt
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

    - Designed in a classic short-sleeve Hawaiian shirt style with a relaxed silhouette and button-front closure.
    - Features a soft and smooth surface that helps showcase all-over printed designs clearly and vibrantly.

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes from 2XS to 5XL, suitable for a wide range of body types and fit preferences.
    📌 Note: There might be a ±5% deviation in length due to manual measurement and production processes.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Vibrant all-over sublimation print: With full-color sublimation, your designs stay bold, fade-resistant, and eye-catching.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a casual fashion shirt and a personalized statement piece.
    - Designed for vacations, beach trips, cruises, parties, summer outings, casual gatherings, and everyday wear.
    - The lightweight and breathable feel helps keep the shirt comfortable in warm weather.
    - Easy to pair with shorts, jeans, skirts, or casual pants for a relaxed and stylish outfit.
    - Perfect for tropical-themed events, personalized gifts, matching groups, and fun seasonal fashion.
    - Suitable for women who want both comfort and standout customized style.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun and thoughtful personalized gift for moms, wives, girlfriends, sisters, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, vacations, beach parties, holidays, anniversaries, and summer celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves Hawaiian shirts, personalized clothing, and creative all-over print fashion.
    - Great for pet lovers, family-themed gifts, travel outfits, and matching group apparel.
    - A stylish gift that combines comfort, personality, and playful design.
    - Adds a fun, relaxed, and memorable touch to any wardrobe🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-4 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 5 – 7 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xWomen's All Over Print Hawaiian Shirt

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
